Treatments in Practice

A glimpse into our certified autologous cell therapy procedures across specialties.

Therapy Protocols

Precision Protocols. Autologous by Design.

PRP

Platelet-Rich Plasma

Concentrated autologous platelets delivering growth factors directly to target tissue. The most widely applied regenerative modality across all 20 specialties.

LocalDermalSub-DermalJointIV
PRF

Platelet-Rich Fibrin

Second-generation platelet concentrate with a fibrin scaffold for sustained growth factor release. Ideal for surgical and wound care applications.

LocalSub-DermalMuscleTendon/Ligament
BMAC

Bone Marrow Aspirate Concentrate

Autologous bone marrow concentrate rich in mesenchymal stem cells and hematopoietic progenitors. Gold standard for orthopaedic and cartilage regeneration.

JointIntra-ArterialMuscle
SVF

Stromal Vascular Fraction

Adipose-derived regenerative cells providing a diverse mix of stem cells, growth factors, and cytokines for systemic and local regenerative applications.

IVLocalSub-DermalIntrathecal
Exosomes

Exosome Therapy

Nano-vesicles derived from autologous cells carrying signalling molecules that modulate inflammation, promote tissue repair, and support cellular communication.

IVLocalIntra-ArterialIntrathecal

For Patients — Your Biology. Your Healing.

Every treatment at Glimmer of Hope uses only your own cells — no foreign substances, no synthetic compounds. Our certified protocols deliver targeted regenerative therapy for lasting outcomes across a wide range of conditions.
